people.imagined: Dawn on the south string above a frozen field. He has found the white bear's straw melting again in midwinter and says nothing; his split lip tightens against the wind as he coils the rope.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge at dawn he looks down toward the paddock with narrowed eyes, deciding to say nothing, a rope in hand; he has found the white bear's straw melting again in midwinter. Face: most important, a deep wind-split crack across his lower lip, red and plainly visible, and a thick coil of pale rope lying on his left shoulder. It is a lean, square-jawed face of about thirty-five, windburned brown, with narrow pale-grey eyes and crow's feet, thick straight brows, a hooked nose and stubble on the jaw. Hair: black and thick, tied back with a leather thong, a few strands whipped across the cheek. Body: wiry and rangy, stooped slightly against the wind. Clothing: a clean, thick felt coat of grass-brown wool with a standing collar and carved horn toggles, a sheepskin collar turned up around the neck, and leather gloves. Hands and objects: one broad hand, split at the knuckles and rope-burned on the palm, holds the end of the rope across his chest; the rope is thick pale hemp in loops the size of a plate, unravelled at one end. Background: a pale winter sky, a blurred long line of grazing horses on frozen grass; a faint brown-gold dust haze at the shoulder. Light: cold, clear dawn light from the upper left, showing the frost on the grass at his boots and the steam of his breath. Expression: stubborn and brave, quietly evasive, the tight mouth of a man who keeps his own counsel.

people.imagined: Spring, at the door of the Hall of Scales, ledger case clutched to her chest like a baby. She watches the reader of the account and thinks the joke has run long enough, and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a hall door in spring, she cradles a flat lacquered case against her chest with both arms like a sleeping baby, looking steadily ahead, patient and unwilling to speak. Face, most important: a flat dark wooden case held in both arms against her chest, and a small round bronze ferry token worn through her hair as a hairpin. A pleasant, round, tired face of about forty-five; olive skin; kind dark brown eyes with shadowed lids; thin level brows; a small nose; lips pressed together in a polite line. Hair: black with a few grey strands, coiled in a low bun, the bronze ferry token pinned through it. Body: stocky, upright, steady. Clothing: a felt coat of undyed wool, clean and fitted, with a plain grass-brown collar and sleeves cuffed in dark blue; a cord belt; a small brass pen case hung at the chest. Hands: both arms wrapped around the case. Background: a blurred pale wall and a spring-green courtyard. Light: soft spring daylight from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-brown haze. The ferry token in her hair is a worn round bronze disc with a square hole, green at its edge, and the case in her arms is dark lacquered wood with brass corners and a cord loop; her cuffs are neatly turned back, and soft light from the courtyard glows on her round cheek and the pale paper wall. Expression: a patient, steady look with lips pressed together and eyes holding back a long-kept opinion.

people.imagined: A salt-carter's son in a stable at night, bargaining over a sack of the stable's spare oats and looking too pleased. One boot is a size too big and slides on his heel.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a stable doorway at dusk, grinning widely and holding up a sack of oats as if about to sell it. Face, most important: thick eyebrows that are salt-white, as if powdered, in a dark-skinned young face, and a tall riding boot visibly too big for his foot, wrinkling at the ankle. A broad, friendly, sun-darkened face of eighteen with a snub nose, wide cheeks, bright brown eyes and a chatty gap-toothed grin. Hair: black, cut short and stiff with salt, sticking up. Body: medium, sturdy, easygoing, leaning on one hip. Clothing: a new grass-brown felt coat of clean wool with horn toggles, open at the neck over a pale linen shirt; a salt-stained leather belt. Hands: a small cloth sack of oats hanging from one fist. Background: a dim stable with stalls and the glowing flank of a horse, a lantern. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left. Qi: a faint grey-gold dust shimmer. The oversized boot is of brown leather, creased at the ankle and loose enough that his heel lifts, while the other fits; salt dust speckles his sleeves, the oat sack is tied with blue string, and the lantern throws a swinging pool of amber on the straw and the pale flank of a horse. Expression: a wide, pleased grin with bright, quick eyes and raised brows, hungry for a deal.

people.imagined: She sleeps beside the white bear in its straw, and wakes to a gentle huff. Straw in her hair, a hoof print on her apron, she sits calm and still while the herd decides about her.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on straw in a paddock at dawn, calm and still, one hand buried in thick white fur beside her as the herd looks on, waking to the gentle huff of the white bear. Face: most important, bits of straw tangled in her hair, and a clear brown hoof print on the front of her canvas apron, plainly visible; at her shoulder the edge of a great white bear's fur and one pale rounded ear edged in blue frost. It is a round, quiet, freckled face of sixteen, pale and pinked by cold, with calm hazel eyes, straight light brows, a short nose and a gentle closed mouth. Hair: light brown, in a long braid with gold straw tangled in it. Body: strong, sturdy and relaxed. Clothing: a clean grass-brown felt jacket with a sheepskin collar, and a pale canvas apron over it carrying the horseshoe-curved hoof print in dried mud. Hands and objects: one freckled hand, scarred with old rope marks, buried in the white fur; a faint blue frost shimmer around the fur. Background: a blurred paddock fence silver with dew, mist at dawn. Light: pale blue-gold dawn light from the upper left. Expression: calm and compassionate, a stubborn, steady patience, as if she could sit there until the herd decides about her.

people.imagined: She has just won a race again, and slides from the saddle with the colt already forgotten. She tells her rival the colts were stolen. The gloves and the studs are all anyone sees.
people.subject: The moment: just back from a race, flushed and breathless, looking sideways with a hard bright smile that is slightly too sharp. Face, most important: a ring of five small bronze studs running around the rim of her left ear, glinting, and riding gloves cut off at the fingertips, held up near her chin. A strong, pointed face of twenty; tan skin with a flush; narrow green-brown eyes; sharp arched brows; a straight nose; thin lips in a hard smile. Hair: dark chestnut, cut short at the neck and wind-tangled, with a leather headband. Body: lean, athletic, forward-leaning. Clothing: a close-cut grass-brown riding jacket of clean felt with a stand collar and brass buttons, a red race sash at the waist. Hands: both hands near the chin, bare fingertips showing. Background: a blurred race track and a pale sky, a horse's head at the edge. Light: bright hard daylight from the upper left. Qi: faint grey-blue dust at her shoulder. The five bronze studs are tiny and set evenly from lobe to rim, each with a bright pin-prick of light; her riding gloves are of tan leather with the fingers cut at the first joint, and the red race sash at her waist is dark with sweat; the dust on the track behind her glows pale gold. Expression: a hard, bright smile a little too sharp, flushed cheeks and a cold flicker in the eyes.

people.imagined: The herd boy stands in the paddock after an hour late, rubbing the back of his neck, thinking of the old horse he wants. He has sold the ride for a purse and is fidgeting.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a paddock gate, he rubs the back of his neck and shifts his weight, looking everywhere but at the viewer, uneasy after a bargain. Face, most important: bow legs, shown in the stance of his hips and the way his coat hangs, and the hand rubbing the back of his neck. A thin, restless, boyish face of nineteen; light brown skin; light hazel eyes that slide sideways; sparse eyebrows; a long nose; a half-grin that comes and goes. Hair: short brown, sticking up at the crown. Body: short and bandy-legged, wiry. Clothing: a grass-brown felt coat of clean fine wool with sleeves too long, leather chaps, a thick scarf of undyed wool; a small purse hidden half under the coat. Hands: one hand behind his neck, the other plucking a thread at his cuff. Background: a blurred paddock fence, tall grass, a white horse in the distance. Light: late afternoon sun from the upper left. Qi: a faint tan dust haze. His legs are noticeably bowed, so that his knees stand out like the bars of a hoop under the chaps, and the purse beneath the coat is a lump of dull red cloth with a drawstring; the grass behind him is long and silvered, and the white horse stands motionless like a statue. Expression: guilty, darting eyes that avoid the viewer, a tight, uneasy mouth and a flush at the neck.

people.imagined: At a writing desk, copying a letter for the second time. Her thumb is black with ink. She has read the offer and knows what it would be called, and she keeps her face still.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing desk, she pauses with a brush above the paper, listening for footsteps, copying a letter a second time in secret. Face, most important: the pad of her right thumb is solid ink-black, held visibly against the brush shaft, and her writing hand slants the wrong way, backward like a left-hander's. A narrow, bookish, pale face of twenty-three; dark steady eyes; thin level brows; a small nose; a controlled neutral mouth. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a single wooden pin. Body: slight, upright, neat. Clothing: a clean undyed felt-wool coat, slate-grey, with a high plain collar, narrow sleeves, a pale blue cuff; sleeve garters on her forearms. Hands: one hand on the brush, the other flat on a sheet of blank paper. Background: a blurred window of pale paper and a lamp on a shelf. Light: cool grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey draught of wind around the paper. The ink-black thumb pad is a perfectly black oval; her fine slanting hand holds the brush upside-down in the odd manner of a left-hander though it is her right, and her sleeve garters are plain grey bands; the paper window behind her is scored with thin dark mullions and the shelf lamp is unlit. Expression: a still, careful face with lowered eyes and a closed mouth, the brow tight and the ears seeming to listen.

people.imagined: At the paddock rail, evening, with a white spirit horse nosing his shoulder. He has been looking at a colt a long time before deciding, the way he looks at everyone. He is waiting for a debt to be paid.
people.subject: The moment: at a paddock rail at evening, he studies the viewer with a long, unhurried look as he does a colt, one hand resting on a white horse's neck. Face, most important: a very large, heavy, slow man with a deeply sun-creased face, and beside his shoulder the long pale head of a spirit horse with a white mane, resting on his coat. Age about fifty-five; brown skin carved with deep creases; small steady dark eyes under heavy lids; thick grey brows; a big nose; a wide still mouth. Hair: grey-brown, long, braided in one thick plait over his shoulder like a mane, with a faded festival ribbon. Body: huge, broad, solid. Clothing: a thick felt coat in grass-brown and undyed wool, clean and heavy, with a sheepskin collar and wide toggles. Hands: one broad hand laid flat on the horse's neck. Background: a blurred dusk plain and a paddock fence. Light: warm low orange sun from the upper left. Qi: a faint tan-gold dust haze. The spirit horse's mane is long, silky and pure white, falling in a curtain over his sleeve, and its eye is dark and calm; his coat is a mass of felt toggles and heavy wool with a curl of sheepskin at the neck, and the faded ribbon in his plait is the red of old brick; the dusk sun gilds the horse's coat. Expression: a long, unhurried gaze with level brows and a still, closed mouth, nothing given away.

people.imagined: She stands facing the wind from the steppe, out of habit, left hand tucked in her sleeve, the frostbitten one. She is thinking of the abbey of six people and how to light it again.
people.subject: The moment: on an open steppe edge, she faces directly into the wind with her chin lifted, coat flapping, her left hand hidden in her sleeve. Face, most important: a long narrow weathered face turned into the wind with eyes narrowed, and a strand of an old grey-blue habit cloth at her collar; the frostbitten left hand tucked inside the sleeve, only its blue-white fingertips peeping. Age about sixty; windburned brown skin with fine deep lines; light grey eyes; thin grey brows; a narrow straight nose; a firm thin mouth. Hair: iron grey, pulled back in a tight low knot with a small ram-horn pin. Body: narrow, upright, spare. Clothing: a grey-blue pleated habit of an old steppe abbey, clean and mended with fine stitches, under a grass-brown felt coat; a ram's-horn pennant tied at the left shoulder. Hands: right hand holding a small plumb line of well-digger's cord, its lead weight hanging. Background: an empty pale sky with wind-combed grass. Light: cold bright light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale wind streak across the frame. The frostbitten hand's fingertips are waxy blue-white and stiff, curling slightly from the sleeve; the ram-horn pennant at her shoulder is a strip of undyed wool on a short pole with a small curled horn, and the wind flattens her coat against her narrow frame and streams her grey hair sideways; the plumb line is a coil of brown cord with a dark lead weight. Expression: a calm, lifted face with narrowed eyes against the wind and a quiet, determined mouth.

people.imagined: A herd master at the north paddock fence, staring at the white bear that upsets the mares. His lip is split and his hands like saddle leather. He is certain of one thing.
people.subject: The moment: at a fence rail, he glares across a paddock at something he wants gone, jaw set. Face, most important: a lip split by a mare's hoof, a thick old scar down through the lower lip, and enormous hands like saddle leather gripping the rail. Age appearing about fifty; deeply tanned and lined face; small hard grey eyes; heavy grey eyebrows; a broad flat nose; a wide stubborn mouth. Hair: grey, cropped short beneath a worn leather cap. Body: short, strongly bow-legged, thick forearms. Clothing: a felt coat in grass-brown and undyed wool, clean and heavy, with a wide sheepskin collar, leather forearm guards; a festival ribbon tied around his upper arm, faded. Hands: both on the rail, knuckles scarred; beside him, her head over the rail at his shoulder, stands his horse Hồng Tông, a short-coupled chestnut spirit mare with a mane like a grass fire. Background: a blurred paddock, mares at the fence, a pale spring field. Light: hard spring light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown dust haze. The mare's-hoof scar splits his lower lip in a thick white seam that pulls his mouth slightly to one side; his hands on the rail are huge and cracked like saddle leather, with a missing fingernail on the left thumb, and the mares behind him toss their heads at the fence; the festival ribbon on his arm is bleached to pink. Expression: a hard glare with a set jaw, a split lip and deep creases beside the eyes, completely certain.

people.imagined: Sunset at the steward's desk, sealing the year's corrected account, signed as Lạc Hà's own custom asks. A reed pen behind her ear. She does the sum quietly, and waits.
people.subject: The moment: at a steward's desk at sunset, she seals a folded sheet with a heavy stamp, calm and unhurried, doing the year's corrected sum quietly and waiting. Face: most important, a reed pen tucked behind her right ear, a pale split reed with an ink-dark tip, and both cuffs stained blue-black with ink, clear in the frame. She appears about forty-five, with a broad, quiet, level face, brown skin, steady dark eyes, strong straight brows, a broad nose and a calm closed mouth. Hair: black with a streak of grey, pulled tight into a plain bun. Body: broad, sturdy and still. Clothing: a clean grass-brown felt coat with a high collar and pale blue cuffs over an undyed linen shirt, and a ring of bronze keys at the belt, partly out of frame. Hands and objects: both broad hands press a stamp, a block of brown wood with a worn brass band, onto a fold of paper; a faint earth-brown glow in the air. Background: a blurred room with a window full of amber sunset, turning the wall apricot. Light: low gold sunset from the left, warming the folded paper under her hands. Expression: just and patient, pragmatic, the settled face of someone who has already weighed the account and will wait for the others to catch up.

people.imagined: He stands in a stance no push can shift, in the outer yard, teaching stable boys to stand like a mountain. He is content, with the face of a man who found his place.
people.subject: The moment: in a wide low stance in a yard he holds still with a mild smile while unseen boys try to push him, teaching stable boys to stand like a mountain. Face: most important, a completely shaven bare head with a high shining dome, faintly stubbled, and heavy square shoulders filling the width of the frame. He is about forty-five, with a round, calm, brown face, small kind dark eyes, thick black straight eyebrows, a thick flat nose and a placid smile. Body: very broad, thick-necked and immovable, with fists resting at his hips and the thumbs tucked in, each as thick as a woman's wrist. Clothing: a clean grey-blue abbey habit of soft old wool, neatly mended at the cuff, under a grass-brown felt coat worn open, and a plain cord belt. Hands and objects: both fists resting at his hips, thumbs in; a faint heavy tan haze at his feet. Background: a yard of packed earth pale with the scuff-marks of boys' feet, a blurred fence and the shapes of boys. Light: bright plain daylight from the upper left, shining on the shaved dome. Expression: humble and patient, content, the unhurried, easy face of a man who found his place and has no wish to be shifted from it.

people.imagined: The victor of the festival, grinning wide, a ribbon braided into her hair. She has the look of a rider about to race anyone, anywhere, and win on the third lap.
people.subject: The moment: grinning widely from the saddle just after a win, chin raised, challenging the viewer to race anyone, anywhere, and win on the third lap. Face: most important, a crooked broken nose, flattened and bent to one side, and a faded red festival ribbon braided into her hair. It is a wiry, grinning, sun-browned face of about thirty-five with bright dark eyes, thick quick brows, a gap-toothed wide smile showing a chipped front tooth, and a small white nick of a scar on the chin. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder with the red ribbon woven through and knotted at the end. Body: lean, hard and forward-leaning. Clothing: a clean, close-cut grass-brown riding coat of felt with a red collar band and brass studs, and a leather riding glove on one hand. Hands and objects: the other glove pulled half off with her teeth, tooth marks on its cuff. Background: a blurred race track and a cheering crowd, a blur of colours and unlettered pennants. Light: bright festival sunlight from the upper left, with a faint grey-gold dust haze in the air. Expression: arrogant and impatient, delighted, a challenging, wide-open grin that dares anyone to ride beside her.

people.imagined: A merchant's grandson in a silk riding coat rained on twice but uncreased, boasting about the horse he picked, charging a copper for the saddling.
people.subject: The moment: leaning against a stall, he boasts with a wide easy smile and holds out a hand for a copper coin, charging for the saddling of the horse he picked. Face: most important, a fine silk riding coat of rich dark wine red, rain-spotted twice but still creaseless where the saddle should have worn it, with a gold-thread button at the neck as bright as a coin. It is a plump, handsome, lazy face of twenty-one with smooth pale skin, sleepy brown eyes, neat black eyebrows, a small nose and a charming smile. Hair: black, oiled and combed, tied back with a silk ribbon. Body: soft and loosely built, leaning with all his weight on the stall. Clothing: the wine-red silk riding coat woven with a pattern of tiny clouds, the rain spots on the shoulder leaving dull circles, over a grass-brown felt vest, with polished unscuffed boots and a jade-green belt. Hands and objects: one hand palm up, a single copper coin shining on it, a faint metallic gleam on the buttons. Background: a blurred stable row with a bay horse craning its neck, a row of horses' heads. Light: warm light from the upper left, bright on the gold thread. Expression: lazy and gregarious, a greedy glint behind the easy smile, the look of a merchant's grandson who expects to be paid for everything.

people.imagined: A ford orphan with a rower's shoulders tells the stable boys he beat his old teacher. A pink burn patch on his chin shines. He eats cheese that is not his.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a hay bale, he waves a piece of cheese and tells a boastful story with a flushed face and bright eyes. Face, most important: a pink burn-patch on his chin, shiny and tight, with a smaller scatter of freckles over his cheeks, and wide rower's shoulders. A square, freckled face of nineteen; ruddy skin; fierce light brown eyes; heavy red-brown brows; a short nose; a grin that tips into a scowl. Hair: ginger-brown, cropped short, a cowlick at the crown. Body: broad-shouldered, thick-armed, short in the leg. Clothing: a clean grass-brown felt coat with the sleeves rolled up to the elbow, a red band at the collar. Hands: a wedge of pale cheese in one fist. Background: a blurred hay-barn and stable boys. Light: warm barn light from the upper left. Qi: a faint red-orange warmth near the chin. The pink burn on his chin is a glossy oval the size of a thumb, his sleeves are rolled over muscular rower's forearms with rope calluses, and the cheese in his fist is crumbling; hay chaff clings to his hair, and the barn light behind is golden and dusty with drifting motes. Expression: a flushed, boastful grin with bright, quick eyes and raised brows, cheese-crumbs at the lip.

people.imagined: She plays the herd home at dusk on a reed pipe, humming through her nose between phrases. The mares answer her before the herd call.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk with a reed pipe held at her chest, she hums through her nose between phrases, eyes half closed, content. Face, most important: a short reed pipe hanging on a red thread around her neck, large and clear against the coat, and her hand holding it. A soft, round, shy face of sixteen; light olive skin; long dark lashes; thin gentle brows; a small nose; a closed humming mouth. Hair: black, in two low braids with red thread woven in. Body: small, slender, relaxed. Clothing: a grass-brown felt coat of clean soft wool with a round collar and toggles, a white wool scarf. Hands: both holding the pipe near her chin. Background: a blurred dusk plain with the dark shapes of mares walking home. Light: lilac dusk light with warm glow from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold sheen in the air near her. The reed pipe is pale yellow with four neat holes and a wrap of red thread at the mouthpiece, hanging on a thread the same red; her small fingers are ink-brown with reed stain, and the dark rumps of mares behind her fade into lilac dusk as a few early stars show. Expression: closed, half-lidded eyes and a content hum with lips pursed, the face calm and gentle.

people.imagined: He has a bandaged hand from the mare that threw him, and stares at the viewer with his grandfather's slow stare. He wants a horse that will not have him.
people.subject: The moment: he stands stiff in a paddock gate, glaring slowly at the viewer, a bandaged hand held up in front of his chest, bitten by the mare that threw him; he wants a horse that will not have him. Face: most important, a thickly bandaged right hand with a rust stain showing through at the knuckles, held up, and a slow, heavy stare copied from his grandfather. It is a heavy, handsome, sulky face of eighteen, brown, with dark deep-set eyes, thick straight brows, a strong nose, and a tight mouth. Hair: black, oiled, in a stiff topknot with a new festival ribbon. Body: tall, stocky and broad in the jaw. Clothing: a clean grass-brown felt coat with a dark blue cuff and fine toggles, and a fur collar. Hands and objects: the bandaged hand, thick linen wound in layers and tied at the wrist with a knot, raised; the other fist grips a neatly coiled halter rope; a faint tan haze in the air. Background: a blurred paddock fence, a grey mare watching from behind it. Light: harsh daylight from the upper left, flat on the pale linen. Expression: ambitious and impatient, a cruel, sulky set to the mouth, the stare of a boy who has decided to be a harder man than he is.

people.imagined: A groom of thirty years sits in the white bear's straw, packing it with river ice. His shoulders are uneven from carrying two buckets. He smells of cold water.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in straw with an armful of river ice, an old groom looks up quietly, a thick white fur beside him; for thirty years he has packed the white bear's straw with ice. Face: most important, uneven shoulders, the left one dropped noticeably lower than the right, and a wooden yoke dark with years of sweat across his neck, two ash-wood buckets with iron bands at the edge of the frame, one dripping. It is a lined, gentle, stubborn face of fifty-five, weathered brown, with small pale-blue eyes, thick grey brows, a bulbous nose and a closed kind mouth. Hair: thin grey, tied in a short tail under a plain wool cap. Body: wide and bent, with strong arms. Clothing: a clean grass-brown groom's smock of heavy wool with the sleeves rolled, over a pale linen shirt, with a leather apron. Hands and objects: both big knuckled hands cradle two blocks of pale blue river ice that steam faintly; the white bear's thick fur shows at his elbow. Background: a paddock in mist, cold straw. Light: cool blue-white light from the upper left, with a faint frost shimmer. Expression: compassionate and stubborn, reclusive, the quiet, patient face of a man who smells of cold water and has no wish to be anywhere else.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age he gathered the plain's horse families into one manor, a tall herder with a cloud-white beard braided like a mane.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of a tall herder standing proud among horses with calm generous eyes. Face, most important: a long cloud-white beard braided in a thick plait like a horse's mane, falling to his chest. A long, lined, kindly face of about fifty-five; weathered brown skin; deep-set grey eyes; white shaggy brows; a high-bridged nose; a calm mouth. Hair: white, long, tied with a leather thong and a festival ribbon. Body: tall, long-limbed, very upright. Clothing: a thick old-style felt coat in grass-brown and undyed wool with a sheepskin collar, clean and well kept; a rope belt; a herder's long crook tucked under one arm. Background: a pale cloudy sky over a plain, the dim shape of galloping horses. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture slightly faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk. Qi: a faint brown cloud-like haze. The braided white beard is tied at its end with a leather thong and a bead, thick as a horse's tail; the crook under his arm is a smooth dark staff with a curved head, and the faint shapes of galloping horses behind him are like pale smudges of cloud; the whole is yellow and faded as old silk. Expression: a calm, kindly face with generous, steady eyes and a quiet smile in the cloud-white beard, faded like old silk.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the herder who was shorted three stones at the horse fair and forgave it the same day. He wears a mended felt cap and looks mildly at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of a gaunt herder with a patient stoop, looking mildly out as if he has just forgiven someone: he was shorted three stones at the horse fair and forgave it the same day. Face: most important, a mended felt cap, its crown mended with a square of reddish felt in a different brown and stitched in coarse black thread, and a gaunt, gentle face. He is about forty-five, with a thin, lined, weather-browned face, mild dark eyes, thin brows, a long nose and a small forgiving smile. Hair: grey-black and short, under the cap. Body: tall, thin and round-shouldered. Clothing: a clean, carefully mended grass-brown felt coat with horn toggles, three different browns across one elbow, a sheepskin collar and a woven belt; the mending is a herder's neat habit rather than poverty. Hands and objects: one hand holds a halter rope loosely; a faint tan haze around it. Background: a pale plain with a distant tent as a pale triangle and faint horse shapes. Light: a soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture slightly faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, with the edges darkened. Expression: a mild, unhurt gaze with soft eyes and a gentle slack mouth, nothing asked of the viewer, faded like old silk.
